title: Topic 12 旅行 Travel
japanese_text: 「<u>間もなく</u>、<u>発車</u>します」というアナウンスを<ruby>聞<rt>き</rt></ruby>いて、<u>ホーム</u>の<ruby>電車<rt>でんしゃ</rt></ruby>に飛び込んだ。<u>ところが</u>、その<ruby>電車<rt>でんしゃ</rt></ruby>は<ruby>特急<rt>とっきゅう</rt></ruby>で、<ruby>降<rt>お</rt></ruby>りる<ruby>駅<rt>えき</rt></ruby>で<u>停車</u>せず、<u>通過</u>してしまった。
english_translation: Hearing the conductor announce "We'll be departing soon," I jumped onto the train sitting at the platform. It turned out, however, that it was an express train and it went right past my station without stopping.
